classes.name: person
classes.description: A person walking, standing, waiting, crossing, or moving alongside or within the road corridor; retain individual instances even when partially occluded.
classes.detection_prompt: pedestrian person walking or standing near a road, visible human body

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Track each person relative to the carriageway, shoulder and nearby vehicles. Escalate the conflict parameter from 0 toward 2 or 5 when repeated close approaches or near-miss trajectories are observed; persons inside live lanes also support jaywalking frequency scoring.

classes.name: motorcycle
classes.description: Two-wheeled motor vehicle, including scooter/motorbike forms, traveling, stopped, filtering, weaving, or cutting across traffic lanes.
classes.detection_prompt: motorcycle or scooter on a roadway

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Track lateral displacement and lane-crossing motion between frames. A sustained lateral cut-in into another road user's path increments unsafe maneuver events; none=0, 1-2 events=2, more than 2 repeated events=5.

classes.name: bicycle
classes.description: Human-powered bicycle, including riders and cargo bicycles, using the shoulder, edge, or active lane.
classes.detection_prompt: bicycle or cycle on a roadway

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Measure lateral crossings and abrupt movements relative to lane geometry and other traffic. Repeated bicycle cut-ins/divergences contribute to the unsafe maneuver count using the 0, 2, 5 thresholds.

classes.name: car
classes.description: Passenger car or small SUV/MPV using the carriageway, shoulder, entrance, or junction area.
classes.detection_prompt: passenger car or SUV on road

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Use tracked vehicle masks/centroids to detect lateral cut-ins, merges and abrupt divergences across lane boundaries. Count distinct unsafe events and map 0, 1-2, or >2 events to ordinal 0, 2, or 5.

classes.name: bus
classes.description: Full-size bus, minibus, school bus, or transit bus occupying a road lane, curbside stop, or junction approach.
classes.detection_prompt: bus or public transport bus on roadway

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Track bus lateral motion and interactions with adjacent lanes. Abrupt lane changes or blocking merges that create close conflicts contribute to the unsafe merging/diverging event count.

classes.name: truck
classes.description: Medium or heavy goods vehicle, lorry, rigid truck, or tractor-trailer on the roadway or roadside.
classes.detection_prompt: truck or heavy goods vehicle on road

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Use tracked masks and lane-relative displacement to identify heavy-vehicle cut-ins, merges and divergences; each distinct unsafe event contributes to the 0/2/5 ordinal scale.

classes.name: auto-rickshaw
classes.description: Three-wheeled motorized passenger vehicle, including autorickshaw/tuk-tuk, operating in mixed traffic or near junctions.
classes.detection_prompt: auto rickshaw three wheeler on roadway

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Track lateral motion, queue insertion and abrupt crossing into adjacent paths. Repeated unsafe cut-ins/divergences are converted to 0, 2, or 5 according to event count.

classes.name: cow
classes.description: Cow or cattle animal standing, walking, grazing, resting, or being herded on the shoulder, median, or live carriageway.
classes.detection_prompt: cow or cattle animal on road

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count distinct animals whose masks intersect the live carriageway. None=0, exactly one rare occurrence=1, more than one distinct stray/herded animal=5; ignore animals fully outside the road danger zone.

classes.name: dog
classes.description: Domestic or stray dog present on the roadway, shoulder, median edge, or junction conflict area.
classes.detection_prompt: dog or stray dog near or on roadway

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count distinct dogs inside the live road corridor. One observed animal maps to rare=1; repeated/multiple animals (>1 distinct animals in the assessed segment) maps to frequent=5.

classes.name: horse
classes.description: Horse, pony, or similar equine animal using the shoulder, carriageway, or junction area, including mounted or unmounted cases.
classes.detection_prompt: horse or pony on road

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count equines whose masks enter the live carriageway. None=0, one rare animal=1, more than one distinct animal=5.

classes.name: sheep
classes.description: Sheep or similar small livestock on or adjacent to the roadway, including groups being herded across the carriageway.
classes.detection_prompt: sheep livestock near or on road

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count individual animals where separable, otherwise group instances conservatively. One animal=1; more than one stray/herded animal=5; none=0.

classes.name: goat
classes.description: Goat or similar small livestock wandering, grazing, or crossing on the roadway or shoulder.
classes.detection_prompt: goat livestock near or on road

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count goats within the live carriageway. One=1, more than one distinct animal=5, none=0.

classes.name: umbrella
classes.description: Commercial parasol, market umbrella, canopy umbrella, or sunshade associated with a roadside selling point.
classes.detection_prompt: roadside market umbrella or vendor parasol

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count distinct active commercial umbrellas within the roadside activity zone. Combine with other commercial-object detections to estimate activity density: none=0, 1-2=2, 3-5=3, >5=5.

classes.name: roadside_cart
classes.description: Pushcart, handcart, street-food cart, produce cart, or similar movable roadside vending fixture encroaching near the road edge.
classes.detection_prompt: roadside vendor cart or pushcart

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count distinct roadside carts in the defined frontage window. Aggregate with kiosks, stalls, tents and commercial encroachments to score activity density on 0/2/3/5.

classes.name: temporary_tent
classes.description: Temporary roadside tent, fabric canopy, pop-up shelter, or stall roof used for commercial activity.
classes.detection_prompt: temporary roadside market tent or fabric canopy

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Each distinct commercial tent contributes one activity unit after de-duplication with vendor_stall. Activity totals map to none=0, 1-2=2, 3-5=3, >5=5.

classes.name: vendor_stall
classes.description: Fixed or semi-permanent roadside booth or street-vending stall with goods, counter, display structure, or customer-facing setup.
classes.detection_prompt: roadside vendor stall street market shop booth

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count distinct commercial stalls per predefined road-frontage segment and de-duplicate overlapping stall components. Totals directly contribute to 0/2/3/5 commercial activity density.

classes.name: chair
classes.description: Roadside seating chair associated with a stall, tea shop, vendor area, or other commercial shoulder activity.
classes.detection_prompt: chair placed roadside outside shop or vendor area

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Treat clustered roadside chairs as supporting evidence of a commercial activity node rather than one activity per chair; aggregate nearby objects to avoid overcounting a single stall.

classes.name: table
classes.description: Roadside table, display table, food table, or merchandise surface associated with a commercial encroachment.
classes.detection_prompt: roadside vendor table or display table

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Use as a support feature for a commercial node; cluster with chairs/benches/stalls before counting. Do not count multiple tables at one stall as separate activities.

classes.name: bench
classes.description: Roadside bench or long seat associated with a shop, market, waiting area, or commercial shoulder occupation.
classes.detection_prompt: roadside bench outside shop or market

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Cluster benches with adjacent commercial objects to infer one activity location; contributes to density only after spatial de-duplication.

classes.name: potted_plant
classes.description: Decorative or merchandise potted plant placed along a roadside shop frontage, cafe, stall, or shoulder encroachment.
classes.detection_prompt: potted plant arranged outside roadside shop

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Treat grouped potted plants as supporting evidence of a commercial frontage, not independent shops; use cluster-level counting for the 0/2/3/5 density scale.

classes.name: advertising_board
classes.description: Freestanding roadside advertisement, promotional board, shop signboard, banner frame, or commercial display facing road users.
classes.detection_prompt: roadside commercial advertising board or shop sign

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count distinct commercial sign/display locations after clustering multiple boards belonging to one business. Aggregate with stalls and carts to derive frontage activity density.

classes.name: parked_truck
classes.description: Commercial truck or heavy vehicle parked/stationary on the shoulder, service lane, frontage, or road edge, often obstructing usable width.
classes.detection_prompt: parked commercial truck on roadside shoulder

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count distinct commercial parked vehicles that form a roadside commercial/loading activity node. Use object tracking to prevent double counting across frames; aggregate with other commercial activities.

classes.name: unloading_van
classes.description: Van or light commercial vehicle stopped adjacent to shops/vendors for loading or unloading, often with goods activity at the road edge.
classes.detection_prompt: delivery van unloading goods roadside

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Count distinct loading/unloading activity nodes per frontage window. Combine with stalls and parked commercial vehicles; map aggregate counts to 0/2/3/5.

classes.name: crosswalk_stripes
classes.description: Visible zebra-crossing stripes composed of repeated transverse painted bars across the pedestrian crossing area.
classes.detection_prompt: zebra crossing white transverse stripes painted on asphalt

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Measure segmented stripe area, local luminance/reflectance contrast against adjacent asphalt, stripe continuity, and visible width. Strong continuous contrast=0; materially faded/poor contrast=1; no detectable crossing=2.

classes.name: faded_crosswalk
classes.description: Residual zebra-crossing paint with broken, faint, worn, low-contrast, or partially erased stripes still indicating a former pedestrian crossing.
classes.detection_prompt: faded worn zebra crossing stripes on asphalt poor paint contrast

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: A confident faded-crosswalk mask with low local contrast or discontinuity maps to score 1. If a crossing is not visually recoverable despite contextual evidence, score 2.

classes.name: solid_white_line
classes.description: Continuous white longitudinal pavement marking used to separate lanes, define road edges, or guide traffic along the carriageway.
classes.detection_prompt: solid white road lane marking line on asphalt

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Assess visible marking continuity, mask fragmentation and paint-to-asphalt contrast. Clear continuous line=0; materially faded/broken line=1; absent across expected geometry=2.

classes.name: dashed_yellow_line
classes.description: Yellow longitudinal road marking rendered as repeated dashed segments separating opposing or special traffic streams.
classes.detection_prompt: yellow dashed lane divider road marking on asphalt

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Compare observed painted segment continuity, width and contrast against expected dashed geometry. Clear/consistent=0; faded or broken beyond normal dash gaps=1; absent where lane geometry indicates a required marking=2.

classes.name: edge_line
classes.description: Longitudinal pavement edge line defining the usable carriageway boundary, typically white and near the road shoulder.
classes.detection_prompt: white road edge line along asphalt shoulder

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Measure longitudinal continuity, visible width and contrast. Clear continuous edge line=0; fragmented/faded=1; missing through an otherwise marked segment=2.

classes.name: faded_lane_marking
classes.description: Residual longitudinal lane marking with low paint contrast, fragmentation, worn edges, or interrupted visibility inconsistent with a clear road marking.
classes.detection_prompt: faded broken road lane marking paint on asphalt

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: A confident faded marking mask with low local contrast or poor continuity supports score 1. If expected marking geometry has no detectable paint at all, score 2; otherwise clear marking=0.

classes.name: pothole
classes.description: Localized depression or cavity in the paved surface with broken edges, dark void, exposed aggregate, or water-filled irregular shape.
classes.detection_prompt: pothole depression or cavity in asphalt road

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Compute pothole mask area relative to road ROI, together with count, depth proxy, severity and spatial clustering. Minor isolated defects support 1; extensive/severe or clustered potholes contributing to breakup support 2; smooth/no meaningful defect=0.

classes.name: alligator_cracking
classes.description: Interconnected fatigue cracking forming polygonal, crocodile-skin patterns across asphalt pavement, often indicating structural distress.
classes.detection_prompt: alligator fatigue cracking network on asphalt road surface

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Calculate cracked-pavement mask area ratio and fragmentation density. Small/localized cracking contributes to 1; broad interconnected fatigue damage contributes to 2; no significant cracking=0.

classes.name: rutting
classes.description: Longitudinal depression or wheel-path deformation visible as paired or repeated troughs along vehicle trajectories.
classes.detection_prompt: road rutting wheel track depressions in asphalt

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Estimate rut extent, persistence along the road and lane coverage. Minor/localized rutting supports 1; deep/widespread wheel-path deformation supports 2; smooth surface without material rutting=0.

classes.name: unpaved_patch
classes.description: Area of gravel, soil, aggregate, exposed sub-base, or temporary unpaved treatment interrupting the paved road surface.
classes.detection_prompt: unpaved gravel dirt patch interrupting paved roadway

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Measure unpaved surface area ratio within the usable carriageway. Small localized patching supports 1; extensive pavement breakup/unpaved coverage supports 2; intact pavement=0.

classes.name: median_barrier
classes.description: Continuous physical median barrier such as concrete, metal crash barrier, modular divider, or substantial central separator controlling opposing flows.
classes.detection_prompt: road median barrier separating opposing traffic

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: At junctions, continuous physical separation with adequate alignment and openings supports proper channelization=0. Broken/inconsistent barriers or poorly controlled islands support 1; no meaningful channelization support=2.

classes.name: traffic_island
classes.description: Raised or painted traffic island, splitter island, refuge island, triangular nose, or directional island used to guide traffic at junctions.
classes.detection_prompt: traffic splitter island or pedestrian refuge island at road junction

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Presence of clearly defined, correctly aligned islands at relevant junction approaches supports score 0. Poorly defined/damaged/uncontrolled islands support 1. Absence where channelization is required supports 2.

classes.name: bollard
classes.description: Vertical bollard, flexible delineator, traffic post, or short protective post defining a channelized edge, median nose, refuge, or pedestrian interface.
classes.detection_prompt: road traffic bollard delineator post at junction or island

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: A coherent series of bollards/delineators reinforcing an island supports proper channelization=0. Missing, sparse or damaged delineation supports 1; no channelization devices where expected supports 2.

classes.name: raised_curb
classes.description: Raised concrete/stone curb defining a median, island, edge, pedestrian refuge, or controlled junction boundary.
classes.detection_prompt: raised road curb defining traffic island or median

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Continuous raised curb geometry supports score 0 when it forms a clear island/median. Broken or poorly controlled curb geometry supports 1; absent channelization features supports 2.

classes.name: view_obstruction
classes.description: Any persistent foreground or roadside object mass that materially blocks the forward sight corridor, including large parked vehicles, structures, dense clutter, or construction objects.
classes.detection_prompt: roadside object blocking forward driver line of sight
classes.associated_safety_param: Is sight distance adequate for safe driving?_ord

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Project obstruction masks into the central driving corridor and estimate visible road distance to the obstruction/occlusion breakpoint. >100 m clear visibility=0; 50-100 m=1; <50 m=2.

classes.name: overgrown_vegetation
classes.description: Dense grass, shrubs, tree growth, hedges, vines, or vegetation extending into or across the sight corridor, shoulder, sign line, or road edge.
classes.detection_prompt: overgrown roadside vegetation blocking road visibility
classes.associated_safety_param: Is sight distance adequate for safe driving?_ord

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Measure vegetation intrusion into the central forward corridor and its longitudinal endpoint. Derive sight distance from the first material occlusion: >100 m=0, 50-100 m=1, <50 m=2.

classes.name: blind_curve_barrier
classes.description: Road geometry or physical edge condition causing a blind curve, including opaque barriers, walls, cut slopes, or curve-side structures that mask approaching traffic.
classes.detection_prompt: blind curve barrier blocking visibility around road bend
classes.associated_safety_param: Is sight distance adequate for safe driving?_ord

feature_mapping_rule.ordinal_impact: Combine barrier mask with road curvature/vanishing-point geometry to estimate the first hidden conflict point. >100 m visible=0, 50-100 m=1, <50 m=2.

Is sight distance adequate for safe driv.aggregation_rule: Estimate the minimum reliable forward sight distance from obstruction/curve masks inside the central driving corridor, using temporal persistence and road-plane geometry. Use the conservative minimum over the survey segment unless a configurable robust percentile is specified.

Roadside commercial activity density_ord.aggregation_rule: Cluster all commercial detections by roadside activity node and frontage window before counting; multiple supporting objects belonging to one stall/business count as one activity node.

Pedestrian-vehicle conflicts_ord.aggregation_rule: Associate pedestrian tracks with vehicle tracks using mask-to-mask distance, time-to-collision proxy, crossing trajectories, and lane occupancy. Count distinct near-miss events, not frames.

Frequency of jaywalking pedestrians_ord.aggregation_rule: Classify pedestrians whose lower-body/contact-point or projected footpoint lies within an active carriageway polygon and whose trajectory is not a legally marked crossing movement. Count distinct events/tracks rather than frames.

Unsafe merging diverging maneuvers obser.aggregation_rule: Use tracked vehicle centroids/masks, lane boundaries, and temporal lateral displacement to identify discrete cut-ins, abrupt merges or divergences that intrude into another traffic path.

Visibility of pedestrian crossings_ord.aggregation_rule: Measure crossing stripe area, stripe continuity, local paint-to-road luminance contrast, geometric regularity and visibility under current illumination.

Road surface condition_ord.aggregation_rule: Fuse defect mask area ratio, defect count, spatial clustering and severity proxies over the drivable road ROI.

Lane marking condition_ord.aggregation_rule: Measure marking continuity, paint contrast, visible width and expected-vs-observed line geometry, separately by marking type and then aggregate conservatively.

Junction channelization_ord.aggregation_rule: Detect junction-zone channelization objects, assess geometric continuity/alignment and whether they meaningfully constrain or guide traffic.

Presence of animals on road_ord.aggregation_rule: Count distinct animal tracks whose masks intersect the live carriageway danger polygon; de-duplicate temporally tracked individuals.
